description: Live SHA256 AsicBoost hashrate rental market. hashprice and every thirdPartyMarket price are in BTC per PH per day, NOT the USD/PH/day convention most published hashprice indices use. networkPhs is raw network hashrate in PH/s. thirdPartyMarket.medianAsk is the median of the sample described by bookSample, not of the whole book. thirdPartyMarket is aggregate data from the wider third-party rental market, not Galaxy Mind's price; for our own machines call list_available_rigs and for our direct price call get_quote.
name: get_hashrate_market
